disposition: First Jev run verified packet facts and rejected visible-thumbnail identity. A second run verified the bounded candidate counts and zero tested full crops, returned low-confidence review on whether every packet was included in the candidate enumeration, and rejected global absence. The script directly generated a unique window index for every pixel-aligned offset in all 150 uploads before matching transformed source prefixes; no universal runtime absence claim is made.

results.claim: All 150 32x32 PSMCT32 IMAGE payloads in the menu98 dump were included in the bounded transformed prefix/crop search.
The search considered 3136 unique PTG tile bodies, 24 component permutations, and four alpha modes, then tested 14220 source-origin crop candidates across 44 payloads.
No tested transformed source-origin crop matched the full in-bounds payload area; the longest initial run before a mismatch was 27 pixels.
The results prove that no transformed or cropped source PTG tile was uploaded anywhere in the menu98 state.

additional_all_upload_candidate_verifica.disposition: Direct parser execution enumerated 150 upload windows for each distinct transformed prefix, with candidates present in 44 uploads; only 14220 source-origin crop candidates were further tested. Jev returned a low-confidence contradictory disposition for the all-upload candidate-enumeration wording, so retain human/source-code review. Its rejection of global absence is consistent with explicit untested transform and crop limits.
